title: Ellaz fighter file
description: What a fighter IS, as opposed to what it looks like (the sprite set's manifest) or what it does (that set's moves file). Speeds are VIEW PIXELS PER SECOND at TICK_RATE, because that is the unit a human can reason about; compile.ts turns each into FP per tick, floored, once.

sprites.description: a directory under ../assets/ holding <set>.manifest.json and <set>.moves.json; data.test.ts asserts both exist

speed.description: view px per second, walking along x

zSpeed.description: view px per second, stepping between lanes
